subject: physics
title: Exercise
textbookText: 1. Two lenses of powers + 12 D and –2 D are placed in contact. What is the focal length of the combination?
2. If we put an object at the focus of a convex lens then, what may be the nature of the refracted rays?
3. What is the minimum distance between an object and its real image of the same size formed by a thin convex lens of focal length f?
4. A convex lens of focal length 16 cm forms a virtual image of double the size of the object. What is the object distance?

5. A converging lens is placed inside a cell filled with a liquid of refractive index 1.60 as shown in figure. The focal length of the lens is 20 cm and its material has the refractive index 1.50 with respect to air. What is the focal length of the system?
6. The line magnification of an image is m. What will be the magnification of its area?
7. Two thin lenses of focal length f1 and f2 are in contact and co-axial. What will be the equivalent power of a single lens of the combination?
